purpose: Bounded Cursor Agent CLI executor for disposable worktrees only. Monitors stream-json, enforces timeout/cancel, resumes with reviewer feedback. Never self-verifies.
inputContract: CourierCursorTask: workspace path (disposable only), objective, allowedPaths, allowedCommands, timeoutMs, optional resumeChatId. Sandbox must be enabled; unrestricted --yolo forbidden.
abortPolicy: On timeout Atlas kills the process tree and marks run timed-out. Never silently verified.
escalationCondition: Auth missing, write outside disposable, missing terminal stream-json result event, or force without sandbox -> fail closed / escalate to CEO.
